name: Unformatted
overview: Irina Serebryakova, an aspiring producer of the Open Channel, inadvertently criticizes her superiors on her personal blog. The post catches the eye of the "general" and after a loud scandal, Irina is given the most hopeless TV show, which is likely to be closed soon. In addition, at the same moment, the groom leaves the heroine and she is left without a roof over her head.
